backend/main.mo: Motoko backend storing contact form submissions, allowing public saves and admin‑restricted retrieval of single or all contacts with authorization checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features to files, components, and test IDs for traceability.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose and functionality of various frontend components and pages.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables, dark mode values, and base styling for the application.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML document loading the React app root and main entry script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures TanStack Router with all site routes and wraps the app in the SiteLayout component.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteFoote: Marketing-site footer with brand info, navigation links, social icons, and contact details.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteHeade: Responsive header with logo, primary navigation, CTA buttons, and a mobile slide‑out menu.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteLayou: Page layout wrapper composing the site header, outlet content, and footer.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Featur: Renders a grid of marketing feature cards with icons, titles, and descriptions.
frontend/src/components/marketing/FormFi: Reusable form field wrapper showing label, child input, help text, and error messages.
frontend/src/components/marketing/LogoSt: Displays a muted section containing a partner logo strip image.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Market: Exports styled primary and secondary button components with size variants.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Sectio: Wraps content in a configurable section with optional muted or gradient backgrounds.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Testim: Shows a testimonial section with quotes, authors, and summary cards in a grid.
frontend/src/components/resources/Relate: Lists related resource cards linking to detailed pages with images and metadata.
frontend/src/components/seo/Seo.tsx: Sets document title and meta tags for description and Open Graph fields on mount.
frontend/src/data/resources.ts: Defines the Resource type and provides sample resource data entries with content.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Initializes and caches a backend actor based on identity and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication state.
frontend/src/hooks/useRevealOnScroll.ts: Hook that applies reveal animations to an element when it enters the viewport.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveContact.ts: Mutation hook that saves a contact form through the actor and invalidates contact queries.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup defining light/dark theme CSS variables, typography, focus styles, scroll reveal animations, and prose formatting.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Provides a cn helper that merges class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with hero content, company story, values, and scroll‑reveal animations.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Implements a contact form with validation, submission via useSaveContact, success state UI, and supporting marketing sections.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Displays the homepage with hero content, feature highlights, benefits, resources preview, and scroll‑revealed sections.
frontend/src/pages/PlatformPage.tsx: Shows an overview of platform capabilities with a hero section, feature breakdowns, and call‑to‑action elements.
frontend/src/pages/ResourceDetailPage.ts: Loads a specific resource by slug, displaying metadata, content, cover image, and related resources with fallback for missing items.
frontend/src/pages/ResourcesListPage.tsx: Renders a scroll-animated resources listing page with SEO metadata and a grid of resource cards linking to detail pages.
frontend/src/pages/SolutionsPage.tsx: Displays industry-specific solution sections with icons, descriptions, and benefits, along with a hero and SEO setup.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helper functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS theme extensions, colors, animations, container settings, and plugins.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s build goals, feature requirements, images needed, and state metadata.
